# Groupon

> Groupon is a local-commerce marketplace where people discover and book discounted experiences, services, products, and travel — things to do, food & drink, beauty & spas, health & fitness, home and auto services, retail goods, getaways, and retailer coupons. Founded in Chicago in 2008, Groupon connects customers with deals from local merchants and brands; members can earn Groupon Bucks credit toward future purchases.

> Deals are time-limited and inventory changes daily — the live deal or category page is always the source of truth for current price, availability, and terms.

## Nearby
- [Automotive](https://www.groupon.com/catalog/automotive)
- [Beauty & Spas](https://www.groupon.com/catalog/beauty-and-spas)

    <style>
      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html {
        font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, FreeSans, sans-serif;
        -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
        -ms-text-size-adjust: 100%;
        color: #333;
        font-weight: 400;
        font-size: 10px;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      }

      body {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        line-height: 2.6rem;
      }

      .page-width {
        width: 1080px;
        padding: 0 32px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .header {
        padding: 22px 0;
        background: #fff;
      }

      .headline {
        font-weight: 300;
        font-size: 3.6rem;
        line-height: 4.6rem;
        margin: 0 0 1rem;
      }

      p {
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        margin: 0 0 1rem;
        font-weight: 300;
      }

      .thanks {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        color: #75787b;
      }

      .main-wrapper {
        margin: 100px 0 0;
      }

      .main-wrapper svg {
        float: left;
        margin: -44px 80px 0 48px;
      }

      /* Reference info box */
      .error-meta {
        margin-top: 2.4rem;
        padding: 1.2rem 1.6rem;
        background: #f5f6f7;
        border-left: 3px solid #53a318;
        border-radius: 2px;
        font-size: 1.4rem;
        color: #75787b;
        line-height: 2.2rem;
        display: inline-block;
      }

      .error-meta strong {
        color: #333;
        font-weight: 400;
      }

      .error-code-label {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #e8f5e9;
        color: #53a318;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        padding: 0.2rem 0.8rem;
        border-radius: 2px;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      @media only screen and (max-width: 1080px) {
        .page-width {
          width: 100%;
        }
        .headline {
          font-size: calc(1.8rem + 1.8vw);
          line-height: calc(2.8rem + 0.9vw);
        }
        .main-wrapper svg {
          transform: scale(.9);
          margin: -44px 25px 0;
        }
      }

      @media only screen and (max-width: 686px) {
        .main-wrapper {
          margin: 0;
        }
        .main-wrapper svg {
          transform: scale(.7);
          margin: 0 auto;
          float: none;
          display: block;
        }
        .headline {
          text-align: center;
        }
        .error-meta {
          display: block;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
